Dinner

Korean Beef Rice Bowls

Savory gochujang beef over fluffy rice, finished with a bright, spicy sriracha mayo. The beef reheats beautifully, so lunch is ready for the week.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
30 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
8

Ingredients

  • Bowls: 300 g dry basmati rice; 24 oz (680 g) 96% lean ground beef
  • 2 tsp sesame oil
  • 1½ tbsp minced garlic
  • 30 g brown sugar
  • 80 g soy sauce (about ⅓ cup)
  • 20 g gochujang (about 1 tbsp)
  • 3 green onions, sliced; sesame seeds, to garnish
  • Sriracha mayo: 90 g light mayo; 50 g sriracha; juice of ½ lemon (about 1 tbsp); ½ tsp garlic powder; 2 tbsp milk or water; salt to taste

Amounts are scaled from 5 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Cook rice according to the package directions. The source uses 300 g uncooked rice, about 750 g cooked.
  2. Whisk soy sauce, gochujang, brown sugar, minced garlic and sesame oil together.
  3. Brown the beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into small crumbles. Drain excess fat if needed.
  4. Pour the sauce over the beef and simmer 3–5 minutes, stirring, until glossy and cooked through. Fold in most of the green onions.
  5. Whisk light mayo, sriracha, lemon juice, garlic powder and milk or water until drizzle-able. Season to taste.
  6. Divide rice and beef among five bowls. Top with sriracha mayo, sesame seeds and the remaining green onion.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
